title: ByteBans
description: A Punishments plugin for server owner. Has the ability to ban, mute, warn and kick. Can even sync punishments across servers.
body:
This punishments plugin was made because there were certain feutures that I wanted, that I could not find in any other punishment plugin out there.
This plugin also has some amazing tab completion. Very much inspired by CoreProtect.
## Features

### Completed Features
- `Tempban/Ban/Unban` Players
- `Tempmute/Mute/Unmute` Player
- `Kick` Players
- (a admin command to refresh the punishments list)
- A console only command to remove punishments from a players History

### Features in Progress
- `Ipban/Ipunban` commands
- `Ipmute/Ipunmute` commands
- `Warn/Unwarn` commands
- `Note/(Removenote/Unnote)` commands
- `History` command
- `Freeze/Unfreeze` commands
- Discord integration
- Custom web page for admins to access
